notes.title: Dev Update v0.3.0: Seasons, Weather & More!
notes.notes:
🌦️ Weather, Seasons, Crafting & More! 🛠️
Hey survivors,

It’s been a while, and I want to start by saying thank you to everyone who's still with us.

Due to some personal life circumstances, I wasn’t able to continue development for a while. But I'm back — and so is the game! We're working hard toward a 2025 release.

Here's what's new in The Risen Survival v0.3.0:
[hr][/hr]🌤️ Dynamic Weather & Seasonal System
A new weather and time system is now live:

Seasons affect temperature, humidity, and crop growth

Your plants respond to changing conditions, just like your character

Adapt your survival strategy to the environment!
[hr][/hr]🛠️ Enhanced Crafting System
We’ve completely reworked crafting to encourage exploration:

Discover new materials

Unlock advanced recipes

Make exploration and survival more rewarding!
[hr][/hr]🗺️ World Expansion & Wildlife
We’re actively building a larger, more detailed world with:

More points of interest and secrets

New enemies and wild animals with unique behaviors
[hr][/hr]🤝 Co-op Mode – Coming After Release
A 4-player co-op mode is in development

Play and survive together in a private lobby

Planned as a free post-launch update
[hr][/hr]
Thank you again for your patience and support.
This project means a lot to us here at Black Engine, and we’re excited to share more with you soon.

If you haven’t already, please wishlist the game and follow us on Steam for upcoming updates.

🔜 More news, gameplay, and a final release date coming soon!

notes.title: Farming Update 1.0
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43452907/2777f3836df10bff6f68497490210c3995ed42fa.png

Introducing the highly anticipated farming update to our survival game! Now, players can immerse themselves in the world of agriculture, plant their own crops, and reap the rewards of a bountiful harvest. Cultivate a variety of plants, from staple grains to vibrant fruits and vegetables, as you master the art of farming. With each passing day, witness the growth of your crops until they are ready to be harvested, providing you with essential resources for survival. Embrace the role of a skilled farmer and let the farming update transform your gameplay experience into a flourishing agricultural adventure!
